name: Straight earth ramp 3 x 4 m, rise 1 m

joins.grid: pivot bottom centre; 3 m wide (x +/-1.5), 4 m long (y -2..+2), rises toward +Y
joins.low_end: toe at y = -2.0, top edge z = 0.03 (sinks under AN06 floor tiles whose top is z = 0.15: no lip to step over)
joins.high_end: flat vertical face y = +2.0, x -1.5..+1.5, top edge z = 1.00 (flat across between the rounded lips)
joins.chain: continue at the high end with a floor/landing at z = 1.0, another AN07 placed at (0, +4, +0.97) on an earth base, or AN08 low end (top 0.5) placed at base z = +0.5 with its low-end centre (x=1.5 of AN08) on x = 0

notes: wedge with a trodden Floor top (faceted +/-2 cm, no snags), rounded Earth lips, slightly bulging crooked Earth sides, closed bottom; thin toe vs 1 m high end. Details: top only flat (<= 5.5 cm: crumbs, flat pebbles, husks, needles, cracks, one rut track); sides with pebbles, clods, ledges, root tips, burrows, cracks, ridges, husks; rubble along the side foot.
